definition: a flat area between two flights of stairs
description: A tall old stairwell with a curving wooden handrail and a big arched window. On the wooden landing halfway up the stairs stands a black grand piano, and a young removal man in a grey T-shirt sits on a cardboard box and plays it while an orange cat walks along the piano. At the end he throws both arms up. His workmates rest on the steps below among moving blankets, one wakes up and claps, and another sits against the wall. Above, neighbours with coffee cups lean over the banisters of the upper floors and smile.
